ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with approximately 5-10% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution restricted to the distal margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white mottling and stippling localized at the far distal tips of both lobes; the central and medial regions are characterized by a solid low-intensity black mass.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate angular aperture of 60-70 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular amplitude serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary; the right lobe exhibits more pronounced, jagged peaks than the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning to a convex sweep at the distal lobe extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast white pixels appearing as stippling on the distal-most points of the left and right fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant morphological irregularity on the far right distal tip, characterized by an apparent truncation and a distinct brownish-orange pixel cluster indicative of physical trauma or encrustation.
